en: \[VSCode] Fixed forked conversations dropping messages: only one of the tool calls Claude ran in parallel was kept, and the last messages a compaction kept were lost, which could leave Claude's answer without the question it answered
zh: \[VSCode] 修复了分叉对话丢失消息的问题：Claude 并行执行的工具调用只保留了一个，上下文压缩保留的最后几条消息丢失，可能导致 Claude 的回答缺少其所回答的问题
